description: AI-Powered Metro Manila Traffic Intelligence & Road Incident Monitoring System

sprints.title: Geospatial Database Architecture & Metro Manila Road Telemetry
sprints.objective: Establish PostgreSQL + PostGIS schema, spatial indexing, Metro Manila road segment geometries (EDSA, C-5, Commonwealth, Quezon Ave), traffic records, and road incidents.

sprints.title: FastAPI REST Services & Routing Engine Integration
sprints.objective: Build FastAPI backend with OSRM/ORS routing integration, PostGIS spatial snapping, /api/v1/route/analyze endpoint, heatmap, and incident queries.

sprints.title: Frontend Implementation via Obsidian Telemetry Design
sprints.objective: Implement React + Vite + TypeScript application strictly conforming to DESIGN/DESIGN.md and DESIGN/code.html with MapLibre GL JS, Route Intelligence Card, and responsive layouts.

sprints.title: AI/ML Congestion Relief Prediction Pipeline
sprints.objective: Train regression models to predict congestion relief duration in minutes (MAE <= 8.5 min), serialize artifacts, and integrate inference into FastAPI route analysis.

sprints.title: System Integration, Route Comparison & Production Readiness
sprints.objective: Complete end-to-end integration across frontend, backend, PostGIS, and ML model; implement alternative route comparison, Docker Compose, and performance verification.

sprints.title: Security Hardening, Rate Limiting & Crowdsourced Incident Consensus Engine
sprints.objective: Eliminate critical vulnerabilities in the public anonymous model: sliding-window rate limiting, Pydantic v2 bounding box validation, spatiotemporal clustering (DBSCAN/quorum), anti-griefing resolution tokens, and half-life decay workers.

sprints.title: Real-Time Geospatial Streaming & Viewport-Filtered Live Telemetry
sprints.objective: Upgrade from 60-second polling to persistent Server-Sent Events (SSE) and WebSockets, delivering low-latency geospatial event deltas filtered by client map viewport and active route buffer.

sprints.title: Philippine Multi-Modal Commuter Intelligence & Corridor Economics
sprints.objective: Empower Metro Manila commuters with street-smart local intelligence: Expressway toll vs free surface cost-benefit analysis, motorcycle lane-filtering velocity adjustments, monsoon flood hazard warning integration, MMDA number coding advisories, and chokepoint cause diagnostics.

sprints.title: Advanced AI Congestion Relief & Spatiotemporal Forecasting Pipeline
sprints.objective: Advance ML inference from simple corridor regression to incident clearance duration modeling, probabilistic quantile bounds (P10/P50/P90), upstream queue spillover prediction, and interactive time-horizon forecasting.

sprints.title: High-Performance Vector Tile Caching, Spatial Redis Layers & Offline PWA Resilience
sprints.objective: Achieve sub-50ms hot corridor response times, implement PostGIS MVT dynamic vector tiles, add Redis spatial caching, and provide Progressive Web App (PWA) offline resilience for commuters facing spotty mobile connections.
